pinev: Centre of the SE¼ sec. 24 T22N R14E, where the 1889 plat draws C. Nordman's 160 acres; two separate 1908 dispatches name the hill; good to about 400 m

tw-wi-new-london-hoffman-orchard.st: The 1889 Waupaca County plat shows "C. Nordman 160" on the SE¼ of sec. 24 T22N R14E (Mukwa), about 2 miles south-southeast of New London: that is Nordman's hill. The pin is the centre of that quarter (BLM section lines).
src: Waupaca County plat, 1889 (Wisconsin Historical Society W0174M6 / W0174N5), Mukwa township
